walkthrough.scope: Synthetic QA identity and disposable database; not a human pilot. Browser actions on loopback, not a physical LAN session.

walkthrough.server_process_outage: Real process stopped; simulation continued, three actions queued, paused cached loopback reload restored draft, local completion pending, restart synchronized same card/Ghost.

walkthrough.recorded: Imported bundled example in UI, played 10 seconds, saved three decisions at tick 0; supplied friendly classification correct, tactical score null and no profile update.

scale.method: 2250 simulation steps per contact size, five Ghost/replay/scoring runs, 50 warm component runs. Local CPU only. Memory is tracemalloc peak, not device RAM or RSS. Empty histories for component dashboard. HTTP concurrency measured separately.

unit.method: Six simulated clients on loopback, three rounds each, unchanged expert policy. Medians/p95 include contention; no physical WAN latency.

browser.method: Five sequential 20-second tests in Codex in-app Chromium on development Mac, fixed medium tier, actual visible DOM measurements. Worker clock is quantized to 0.1 ms; zero means below timer resolution. No whole-process/browser memory access. At capture time the Mac had not been identified as the weakest team laptop. The user subsequently identified it; a fresh fixed-tier repeat and verified hardware fields are recorded in performance-laptop.json.

experiment.label: SIMULATED TRAINING EXPERIMENT — NOT HUMAN EFFICACY EVIDENCE
experiment.method: Paired seeds, identical initial hidden probabilities, assessment uniforms and focused learning law. Production Thompson selector/template adapter/Red Force versus uniform random focus/template; identical Beta-based difficulty rule. One abstract Bernoulli assessment per canonical skill/session. Hidden competence is separate from Beta estimates. No tactical physics, human learners or empirical learning-rate calibration.

remaining: No human efficacy study conducted. Consent-gated pre/post tooling is available.
